```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")
library(shadowtext)
```

Exomiser's automated ACMG classification, ESTABLISHED vs NON-ESTABLISHED
genes. Needs the tables written by `02_read_filter_save.Rmd`.

## Data

```{r data}
acmg_levels <- c("NOT_AVAILABLE", "BENIGN", "LIKELY_BENIGN",
                 "UNCERTAIN_SIGNIFICANCE", "LIKELY_PATHOGENIC", "PATHOGENIC")

acmg_to_plot <- read_all_vars() %>%
  mutate(ACMG = factor(EXOMISER_ACMG_CLASSIFICATION, levels = acmg_levels)) %>%
  count(ACMG, GROUP, name = "Freq") %>%
  complete(ACMG, GROUP, fill = list(Freq = 0)) %>%  # keep empty classes
  group_by(GROUP) %>%
  mutate(Prop = Freq / sum(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup()

stopifnot(!anyNA(acmg_to_plot$ACMG))  # an unexpected ACMG class would be dropped silently

knitr::kable(acmg_to_plot, digits = 3)
```

## Plot

```{r plot, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}
label_font <- "Econ Sans Cnd"

acmg_automated_barplot <- ggplot(acmg_to_plot, aes(x = Prop, y = ACMG)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = GROUP), width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  # white counts inside long bars, outlined black counts elsewhere
  geom_text(
    data = filter(acmg_to_plot, Prop >= 0.5),
    aes(x = 0, label = Freq),
    hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.3, colour = "white", family = label_font, size = 7
  ) +
  geom_shadowtext(
    data = filter(acmg_to_plot, Prop < 0.5),
    aes(x = 0, label = Freq),
    hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.3, colour = "black", bg.colour = "white", bg.r = 0.2,
    family = label_font, size = 7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ GROUP) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text       = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")) +
  labs(x = "PROPORTION OF VARIANT-PARTICIPANT PAIRS", y = "AUTOMATED ACMG CLASSIFICATION")

acmg_automated_barplot
```

## Save

```{r save}
out_name <- paste0("Exomiser_ACMG_plot", file_suffix)

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0(out_name, ".tiff")), acmg_automated_barplot,
       width = 8, height = 8, device = "tiff", dpi = 700)
save(acmg_automated_barplot, file = file.path(images_dir, paste0(out_name, ".RData")))
```
